episodes.title: Culty Work Environment vs. Company Culture: What's the Difference
episodes.description:
How do you know if your values don't align with your job, and is that just corporate culture or a cult? This week we're getting into: signs your workplace is a cult, signs your personal values don't align with your job, toxic workplace red flags, and how to know if your job is genuinely toxic or just not the right fit. 
We talk about how much influence a job should actually have over your personal values, why "we're a family" is usually a red flag, and why vague core values like "quality" and "integrity" mean absolutely nothing. How banned words and secret rules only get revealed after you've already broken them. Why the most "open and inclusive" workplaces are so often the most toxic underneath. Whose fault it actually is when you're doing great work but still feel like an outcast. And the exact 8-point checklist psychologists use to identify cult-like behavior, hit most of these boxes and you're not just misaligned with a culture, you're in a cult. We don't think every mismatch is a conspiracy. Sometimes it's just not your people. 
If you've ever felt like you had to censor who you are to survive at work, or you're not sure if it's you or the environment, this episode will help you figure it out.

Hoe to CEO is a real talk podcast about the frustrations, pressures, and double standards ambitious women deal with at work, in relationships, and in life. 

Hosted by Anastasia and Madison. New episodes every Friday.
